report_name: Epic Systems Halts Development to Fix MyChart Security Flaws

vulnerabilities.name: MyChart Patient Record Access Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: A set of security flaws in the MyChart patient portal that could potentially allow an external party to access sensitive patient medical records without the access being logged.

identities.name: Epic Systems
identities.description: A leading provider of electronic health records (EHR) and the vendor of the MyChart patient portal. The company paused product development to address critical security flaws discovered in its software.
